jobs.label: Find in Knowledge
jobs.meaning: find a page, a policy, a handbook entry or a how-to the company wrote down
jobs.note: WS-61 KB-12 (knowledge_base.md section 11). The jobs landed with the promotion to live, and not before: held_jobs filters a job by feature and not by launch status. A link job to the Search view.

jobs.label: Write a page
jobs.meaning: write a new page of company knowledge, such as a policy, a handbook entry or a how-to
jobs.note: WS-61 KB-12. Opens the New page form, and it saves nothing.

jobs.label: Add a product
jobs.meaning: add a product of the company to the Knowledge directory, with a name and other names
jobs.note: WS-61 KC-8e. Opens the KC-8d Add a product form. The layout listens for the ?do= and does nothing for a member with no space to write in. No fields: the form saves nothing.

jobs.label: Add a topic
jobs.meaning: add a topic to the Knowledge directory, with a name and other names
jobs.note: WS-61 KC-8e. Opens the KC-8d Add a topic form. The layout listens for the ?do= and does nothing for a member with no space to write in. No fields: the form saves nothing.
